sim.title: Simulation
sim.description: Paper defaults lock Device 1, N=600. Factory (x, y) is visualization only.

hints.numDevices: Tag count N. Paper Figure 5(b) uses N = 600. (x, y) on the floor is display only; $p_{\mathrm{in}}$ comes from the digitized CDF.
hints.deviceType: Device 1 is the Figure 5(b) energy model ($E_{\max}$ = $E_{\mathrm{up}}$ = 500 nJ, $E_{\mathrm{low}}$ = 250 nJ). Device 2 is the other Table 1 row.
hints.strategies: All selected strategies share the same random numbers (same $p_{\mathrm{in}}$, positions, energy phases).
hints.em: Energy-aware monitoring. Next paging starts when the previous CBRA ends (paper strategy 1).
hints.dcm1: Discontinuous coverage mode, one group. All devices share the same ON window.
hints.dcm4: DCM with 4 groups. Group assigned at first paging (spread). Each paging serves one group. Paper: ~50% $T_{99}$ cut vs EM.
hints.seed: PRNG seed. Same seed + same N replays the identical Monte Carlo draw: floor (x, y), $p_{\mathrm{in}}$, energy phase, and every access coin-flip. Devices do not walk; the factory “route” is only state playback. Change the seed, then Run, for a new layout and inventory order. 42 is the paper-reproduction default.
hints.maxTime: Simulation horizon in seconds. Paper qualitative: EM $T_{99}$ around 20 s. Web snapshots are stored every 100 ms.
hints.earlySleep: Not the paper default (unchecked). If checked, devices that fail the access-probability draw SLEEP after the 1 ms paging instead of remaining ON for Table 1 $T_{\mathrm{on}}^{\mathrm{DCM}}=3\,\mathrm{ms}$. That is an unpublished duty-cycle optimization. Paper configuration keeps the box unchecked.
hints.sleepNetMin: Paper: $\Delta E=(P_{\mathrm{eh}}-P_{\mathrm{sl}})\Delta t$. Weak tags still drain in SLEEP. This box is the lower bound $x$ in $P_{\mathrm{net}}=\max(x,\,P_{\mathrm{eh}}-P_{\mathrm{sl}})$. Empty or $-\infty$ is the paper formula. $0$ stops SLEEP drain (not a paper claim). Units: nW.

assumptions.title: Parameters vs assumptions
assumptions.loadPaper: Load paper config from the API.

paperHints.E_max_nJ: Storage cap. Device 1: 500 nJ. Same as $E_{\mathrm{up}}$.
paperHints.E_up_nJ: Energy to finish the ON / access procedure. Device 1: 500 nJ.
paperHints.E_low_nJ: Wake threshold. Below this the device is OFF. Device 1: 250 nJ.
paperHints.T_on_DCM_ms: Published DCM ON window: 3 ms (arXiv had 2 ms).
paperHints.N: Number of devices in this run.

assumptionHints.pin_source: $p_{\mathrm{in}}$ is sampled from the digitized Fig. 5(a) CDF, not from factory (x, y) path loss.
assumptionHints.warmup: How initial energy is set. `stationary` = closed-form cycle phase; `explicit` = ON/OFF machine for $warmup_s$ from $E_{\mathrm{low}}$. They are not equivalent.
assumptionHints.access_probability: Paper gives no $p_{\mathrm{access}}$ equation. Default `occupancy_counts` is a Schoute load estimate from idle/singleton/collision AOs.
assumptionHints.aperiodic_paging: EM: next paging as soon as the previous CBRA ends.
assumptionHints.periodic_paging: DCM: fixed global epochs $0, T_{\mathrm{pg}}, 2T_{\mathrm{pg}},\ldots$. Overrun skips that occasion.
assumptionHints.group_assignment: Default first_paging_spread: group is drawn at first paging detection so simultaneous hearers are not dumped into one group. even_id_mod / random_preconfigured are preconfigured splits. first_paging_mod uses paging index mod N_g.
assumptionHints.off_clears_sync: Default true: OFF drops DCM sync and the device must hear paging again. False keeps sync and recharges until the next group epoch.
assumptionHints.sleep_when_not_attempting: Paper default false: after inventory-stage sync, each DCM occasion stays ON for Table 1 $T_{\mathrm{on}}^{\mathrm{DCM}}=3\,\mathrm{ms}$, including devices that do not attempt Msg1. True is experimental early-sleep (1 ms paging then SLEEP) — not the published model.
assumptionHints.dcm_on_mode: `strict_paper_fixed_ton_dcm` is the paper configuration. `experimental_early_sleep_after_access_rejection` shortens unused ON windows; do not treat it as the IEEE default.
assumptionHints.sleep_net_power_min: SLEEP net-power floor. `-inf` is the paper: $P_{\mathrm{eh}}-P_{\mathrm{sl}}$. A finite nW is experimental $\max(x,\,P_{\mathrm{eh}}-P_{\mathrm{sl}})$. $0$ means SLEEP cannot drain.
assumptionHints.p_access_scope: per_group: each paging/group has its own access probability (p is in the paging message). global shares one p.
assumptionHints.channel_errors: Noise, interference, and decoding failures are not simulated. Msg1 fails only on collision or energy depletion.

anatomy.title: Device internals
anatomy.subtitle: Two blocks on one batteryless tag
anatomy.wurHint: A 1 μW receiver that only asks “is someone calling me?”. Paper: useful for Device 2 (main IC $P_{\mathrm{rx}}$ = 50 μW). Not used in Device 1 Figure 5(b).
anatomy.icHint: The radio that does inventory. Device 1: $P_{\mathrm{rx}}$ = $P_{\mathrm{tx}}$ = 1 μW. This is what Figure 5(b) models.
anatomy.d1Note: This run is Device 1: the main IC listens. The wake-up receiver is drawn for structure; it is not in Figure 5(b).
anatomy.d2Note: This run is Device 2: the 1 μW wake-up receiver can listen instead of keeping the 50 μW main IC on.

inspect.title: Device inspector
inspect.empty: Click a tag on the factory floor.
inspect.energyHint: Stored energy $e_{\mathrm{ES}}$. $E_{\mathrm{low}}$ = 250 nJ to wake, $E_{\mathrm{up}}$ = $E_{\max}$ = 500 nJ. OFF below $E_{\mathrm{low}}$.
inspect.pinHint: Received RF power from the digitized Figure 5(a) CDF, clipped at −36 dBm. Not computed from (x, y).
inspect.pehHint: Harvested power $P_{\mathrm{eh}} = \eta(p_{\mathrm{in}})\, p_{\mathrm{in}}$. Efficiency $\eta$ uses the published piecewise formula (not the arXiv swap).
inspect.groupHint: DCM group after first paging. Default first_paging_spread. EM has no group.
inspect.attemptsHint: Number of $\mathrm{Msg}_{1}$ access attempts by this device.
inspect.completionHint: Time when this device finished inventory. Figure 5(b) is built from these times, not a fitted curve.
inspect.firstPagingHint: First time this device heard paging. Written once; later resyncs go to last-sync.
inspect.lastSyncHint: Most recent inventory-sync time (may be a resync after E_low).
inspect.syncCountHint: How many times the device gained DCM sync vs how many times it hit E_low while synced.

energy.title: Energy history
energy.empty: Select a device to plot stored energy vs time.
energy.frozen: Frozen after DONE — not physical evolution
energy.bgLegend: Background: OFF harvest, ON monitor, SLEEP, TX. Markers: paging, Msg1, collision, Msg2, Msg3, DONE.

cbra.title: CBRA / AO
cbra.subtitle: 4 time × 2 frequency = 8 AOs
cbra.pAccessHint: $p_{\mathrm{access}}$ for this paging. Paper has no equation; this is an idle-AO Poisson load estimate.
cbra.eligibleHint: Devices that heard paging and have enough energy to attempt CBRA.

metrics.fromTimes: From completion times, not a fitted curve

maps.paperExpect: Paper expectation (qualitative, not a fitted target)
maps.legend: Drag nodes to tidy the layout; Reset layout restores the default. Rounded = energy · square = protocol · pill = decision · sharp = failure · check = success. Dashed/animated edges are retries or sleep loops.

expect.em: Published text: Device-1 EM T99 ≈ 20 s (P1: near $E_{\mathrm{low}}$ at $p_{\mathrm{in}}\approx-36\,\mathrm{dBm}$). This run is a Monte Carlo realization. PASS/FAIL is the automatic check, not a claim that the curves overlay the IEEE plot.
expect.dcm1: DCM 1-group should not improve Device 1 much versus EM: all N still share one contention group.
expect.dcm4: Published figure: DCM 4-groups about 10 s / ~50% T99 cut versus EM. Automatic PASS requires that band (30–70%), not an 80% collapse from early-sleep.

em.summary: ON is energy-thresholded. Paging is aperiodic. Weak devices recharge E_low→E_up on the order of 20 s.
em.steps:
OFF harvests until E_up.
ON monitors paging and does not harvest.
Access draw: reject keeps monitoring.
Msg1 collision waits for the next paging.
Singleton: Msg2 RX, Msg3 TX, DONE if energy remains.

dcm1.summary: All 600 Device-1 tags share one group. Low p_access; many hear paging and pay monitoring energy without transmitting.
dcm1.steps:
Pre-inventory ON timer 18 ms, then OFF if no paging.
First paging synchronizes to 12 ms.
Each synced occasion stays ON for Table 1 $T_{\mathrm{on}}^{\mathrm{DCM}}=3\,\mathrm{ms}$ unless OFF, DONE, or CBRA lasts longer.
Optional experimental early-sleep: no-attempt devices SLEEP after paging.
E_low clears sync.

dcm4.summary: Group assigned at first paging detection (spread, not paging-index dump). Wake every 48 ms; paper default ON duration is still 3 ms.
dcm4.steps:
First paging synchronizes and assigns a group.
Default first_paging_spread: simultaneous hearers are not all group 0.
Wake when paging_index mod 4 = g.
N_g × T_pg = 48 ms.
Per-group p_access from AO occupancy.

curve.title: Figure 5(b)
curve.subtitle: from completion times, not a fitted curve.
curve.panHint: Drag the bar under the plot to pan time. Double-click the plot to show the full run.
curve.paperDigitized: Grey dash-dot: digitized IEEE Fig. 5(b) CSV. Dotted verticals: paper-stated T99 (EM ≈ 20 s, 4-group ≈ 10 s).
curve.paperMarkersOnly: No digitized Device-1 CSV in the repo. Dotted verticals mark paper-stated T99 only (EM ≈ 20 s, DCM+grouping ≈ 10 s) — not invented curves.

overview.title: Reader ↔ device
overview.lead: One paging cycle. A device that is not ON never hears paging.
overview.steps:
Reader sends paging.
Only ON devices hear it.
Access probability: skip or pick an AO.
Collision waits for the next paging.
Singleton: Msg2, Msg3, DONE.
